issues.display_title: Issue #2076: fix(payment): Photo Studio subscribe returns subscription_plan_not_found (User 31611)
issues.main_description_html:
Problem Description

QA reported that subscribing to the Photo Studio plan as User 31611 fails, and the API returns messages.tours.subscription_plan_not_found (HTTP 409).

User

  • User ID: 31611
  • The user is in the Stripe test user list (HelperClass::getStripeTestUserIds()), so the subscribe flow runs in Stripe test mode and reads the *_test plan IDs.

Possible Sources

The error is thrown in several places. Need to confirm which one this request hits:

  • SubscriptionClass::addSubscription(): plan key not found in the Redis Stripe plans (test mode).
  • PaymentHelpers::getPlanDetails(): Photo Studio product not found or amount <= 0 (e.g. one_time_payment = 1, because photo_studio / photo_studio_year only map to a product for recurring).
  • PaymentHelpers::getPlanDetails(): product row has no plan_stripe_test / plan_paypal_test plan ID.
  • PayPal CreateSubscription paths, if the subscribe went through PayPal.

Acceptance Criteria

  • AC-001: Find which endpoint, payload (plan, one_time_payment, processor) and throw site produce the error for User 31611.
  • AC-002: Root cause identified with evidence (code path + product / plan data).
  • AC-003: Fix applied (code or data). If it's data only (e.g. a missing test plan ID), document the exact change needed.
  • AC-004: Check whether non-test users and both Photo Studio Monthly / Yearly are affected too.
  • AC-005: User 31611 can subscribe to Photo Studio successfully.

Result

Root cause (AC-001, AC-002)

  • Endpoint: POST /v2/payment/subscription/subs (Stripe). User 31611 has user_extra_data.one_time_payment = 1.
  • PaymentHelpers::getPlanDetails() calls HelperClass::getProductIdByName('photo_studio', 1). photo_studio / photo_studio_year only mapped for recurring (subscriptionType = 0), so it returned 0 → subscription_plan_not_found (409).
  • Affects every user with one_time_payment = 1, for both Monthly and Yearly (AC-004). Recurring users were not affected.

Fix (AC-003)

  • Data: one-time products 46 / 47 added to ccdb.product (#2085), and ccdb.cc_purchase.product_id enum extended to '47' (#2086). Both done on production; staging uses the same ccdb.
  • Code: Gitea PR #2093 → staging (commits 1ff9ab1a7, 880834117)
    • ProductID::PHOTO_STUDIO_ONE_TIME = 46, PHOTO_STUDIO_YEAR_ONE_TIME = 47; getProductIdByName maps them for subscriptionType = 1.
    • Cron process-unsubscribes-photo-studio-table Flow 2 moved to PhotoStudioUnsubscribesSweeper and only processes rows with next_payment_date < today. Before, a one-time buyer lost access on the next cron run.
    • ClaimTrial purchase history and the Photo Studio hard reset include 46 / 47.
  • Behavior change: recurring Photo Studio unsubscribe / downgrade rows are now processed after the end of the period, not on the next cron run.

Tests (2026-10-27, local backend + local MySQL/Redis, Stripe test mode)

  • phpunit: HelperClassGetProductIdByNameTest 12 tests OK, PhotoStudioUnsubscribesSweeperTest 6 tests OK.
  • E2E with User 19311 (Stripe test user; one_time_payment set to 1 locally, restored to 0 after testing):
# Case Result
A One-time photo_studio 200; recurring_profile_photo_studio = pi_…, photo_studio = 1, cc_purchase.product_id = 46, unsubscribes_photo_studio.next_payment_date +30 days, cc_logs, receipt PDF ✅
C One-time photo_studio_year 200; photo_studio = 2, product_id = 47, amount 120, next_payment_date +365 days ✅
3DS One-time photo_studio with a 3DS card 202 requires_action + client_secret → challenge completed → complete-3ds 200, product_id = 46, +30 days, Redis key removed ✅
B Cron before / after next_payment_date before: not processed, access kept; after: profile cleared, photo_studio = 0 ✅
B3 Cron, yearly row due in 2027 not processed ✅
E Subscribe again while Photo Studio is active 409 Subscription not allowed, no charge ✅
G POST /photo-studio/claim-trial with only 46 / 47 purchases 409 trial not available ✅
F test-reset-photo-studio-subscription?hard_reset=true 46 / 47 purchase rows deleted ✅
D Regression: recurring photo_studio (one_time_payment = 0) 200; Stripe Subscription sub_…, product_id = 44, no unsubscribe row ✅
H Unsubscribe recurring Photo Studio, then cron row next_payment_date = period end (2026-11-27); cron keeps access ✅
T2/T3 Cron downgrade (change_plan_to = 1) + Flow 1 with an active Stripe sub photo_studio 2 → 1, not reset ✅; Flow 1 with a missing sub → reset ✅

Staging (2026-10-27)

  • Gitea PR #2093 merged to staging (f3e638775), then staging merged to main (origin/main = f1fb18c01).
  • Tested by the user on staging: passed. Production deploy goes through promote-production with the verified staging SHA (docs/TEAM_CICD.md).

Notes

  • AC-005: E2E above used User 19311. After #2093 was merged to staging, the user tested on staging (2026-10-27) and confirmed it passes.
  • Not in scope / waiting on PM: PayPal one-time for Photo Studio (CreateOrder::buildOrderDataForProduct only lists the 6 main plans), and the FE "charged monthly" copy.
  • Existing issues found while testing (not caused by this fix):
    • ElasticLogClass::addLog re-throws connection errors, and the success email (Plunk) error is not caught. Either one fails after the card is charged, so the API returns an error although the user paid and got access.
    • cc_purchase.date_purchase is saved in UTC while other tables use local time.
    • Untranslated response messages: messages.payment.subscription_retrieved_success, messages.users.subscription_reset_success.
